unknown_capacity.rule: Only the validation-ranked first proposal is carried into the unknown-boundary comparison; no formal reward ranking chooses it.

shifted_foundations.interpretation: Separate domain-generator and independently initialized W0 stress test; not a standard SOTA benchmark.

parent_recycle_validation.rule: Compare both paired variants on validation online signed reward; all outcomes retained. The independent capacity cohorts are not used for threshold selection.
parent_recycle_validation.evidence: Both variants use the same fixed-size cumulative resident statistics; only parent recycling differs.

parent_recycle_formal.rule: Run only if parent-recycle validation improves at least one method in mean online reward; preserve its fixed-parent control and report all three paired formal seeds.

budget_baseline.timing: Added after first controlled formal results; not used to choose or tune a proposal rule.
budget_baseline.fairness: Same total real training-stream interactions as the shared cache, not identical per-bout dwell times or identical PPO update counts; report compute separately.

parent_recycle_unknown_followup.condition_rule: If known-parent formal has a positive mean paired gain for at least one condition, carry the condition with the largest validation mean recycle gain into fresh unknown seeds; do not change thresholds.
parent_recycle_unknown_followup.additional_control: independent7 budget baseline on the same three fresh seeds
